newsitem.title: SPAIN: Gas Natural 9-mth net profit seen up 22 pct.
newsitem.headline: Gas Natural 9-mth net profit seen up 22 pct.

text.p: Spanish energy group Gas Natural is expected to see an average 22 percent increase in attributable profit to around 30 billion pesetas for the nine month to September, analysts polled by Reuters said.
Energy analysts consulted at Central Hispano Bolsa, Banesto Bolsa, BBV Interactivos and ABN-Amro said the firm's performance would be much in line with the rest of the year.
Gas Natural is due to release nine-month figures on Tuesday.
In the nine-months to September 1995, Gas Natural posted attributable profit of 25.15 billion pesetas.
Analysts said the company does not normally release a full breakdown of figures, but one trend which should emerge is further cost containment.
